claim: A position may carry a terms block: entries of shape {term, definition, anchor?}. A term naming a code construct anchors to its defining site, so the definition is a navigable stop; prose-only definitions remain valid for terms with no code referent.

evidence.detail: Pinned in execution of b511 from the position's design-rationale appendix (appended 2026-06-11 at user direction after the b511 self-bootstrap audit found the rationale reachable only through an unresolvable session: slug - the b518 gap). The terms block is the one b511 format element not yet mechanized in skills/position/SKILL.md; it stays optional in the format until a worked instance needs it.
